title: Codimension-zero integer lattice approximation with boundary mass bounds
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, and let X ∈ D_n(ℝ^n) be integer multiplicity with M(X) < ∞ and M(∂X) < ∞. Then there are scales ρ_k > 0, integer coefficients β_k : LatticeFaceIndex n n → ℤ and currents P_k ∈ D_n(ℝ^n) with IsLatticeChain ρ_k β_k P_k for all k (P_k = Σ_F β_k(F)[[F]] over the n-cubes F of 𝓛_n(ρ_k)), P_k ⇀ X weakly, and sup_k M(∂P_k) < ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ (ρ : ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℕ → LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1) → ℤ) (Pk : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), (∀ k, 0 < ρ k) ∧ (∀ k, IsLatticeChain (ρ k) (fun F => (β k F : ℝ)) (Pk k)) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn Pk X ∧ (⨆ k, (Pk k).boundary.mass) < ∞
